scripts.dev: bun run dev:setup && lerna run dev --concurrency 2 --scope lennette-web --scope @lennette/api
scripts.dev:api: bun run dev:setup && bun run --cwd apps/api dev
scripts.format: cargo fmt --all && bun run --cwd apps/web format
scripts.test:integration: bun --no-env-file scripts/dev-env.mjs api cargo test -p lennette-server --tests -- --ignored
